purpose.summary: Part of the JMA (Japan Medical Association) ORCA open-source medical receipt (claim) processing system. This program (ORCR0620) handles inpatient receipt basic information — reading, editing, and writing indexed receipt files (RECE61–RECE69) for hospital admission claim records. It appears to be a batch program that constructs or updates receipt records for inpatient billing submissions to Japanese health insurance.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims)

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the Japanese comments are actually Shift-JIS or EUC-JP encoded, resulting in garbled display. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software from the well-known Japanese open-source ORCA project. COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) not shown in the truncated source. The source was truncated at 16000 chars out of 213495 bytes, so only the header, comments, ENVIRONMENT, and start of DATA DIVISION are visible, but all indicators confirm genuine COBOL.
